LESSON: SIGN READING 11.2.1 FLUENCY

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.2: Sign Reading 11.2.1 Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 11.2.1 Fluency, part of Strand 11 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to read fluently? 2. How can we improve our sign reading speed?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 11.2.1 Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: Knowing my school and home as the learner learns about the environment.

● Digital literacy: Creating with technology as the learner participates in a reader’s theatre with peers and records on a digital device.

Values:
Responsibility: Hard work as the learner takes charge of own learning by reading accurately

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills: Effective communication as the learner plays word ladder game to practise correct pronunciation of words..

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to relate sign reading fluency to reading that is emphasised in Indigenous Language Activities.
